test_title: PYST 30: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The painting was not made by you.

options.text: You should not make the painting.
You does not make the painting.
You did not make the painting.
You do not make the painting.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**You did not make the painting.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Active voice means the subject performs the action of the verb.
 
• In this sentence, the subject is "**you**" and the verb is "**make**."
 
• To change to active voice, we need to make "**you**" the subject and "**make**" the verb.
 
• The **correct active** voice sentence is "You did not make the painting."

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.
